As Daisy walked, she saw a big, green frog. Daisy was so excited and wanted to get closer. She asked the frog, "Can I pet you?"
The frog said, "Yes, but you must be careful. You must be very careful."
Daisy was so happy and she slowly reached out to touch the frog. The frog was so soft and gentle. Daisy smiled and said, "Thank you, frog!"
The frog smiled back and said, "You're welcome, little one."
Daisy was so happy that she had made a new friend. She waved goodbye to the frog and went back home.
The end.

examples.prompt: Please tell me a tale about Tim.

Tim ran to his mom and told her about the fierce dog. His mom hugged him and said, "Don't worry, Tim. The dog is just a big, fierce dog. He won't hurt you."
Tim felt better and went back to playing with his ball. He kicked the ball and watched it go far away. The fierce dog followed Tim and found the ball. Tim was happy and played all day long.
